internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Sisters. Triplets. Co-founders. At Pappy & Company, we are fortunate to be able to work together, combining family and business (and the occasional after-hours cocktail) in an effort to share the Van Winkle bourbon legacy and lifestyle with all of our customers. Based in two offices in Louisville, Kentucky, and Sun Valley, Idaho, we lean on our small but mighty Pappy & Company team in order to manage all our customer service, inventory, and fulfillment in-house.
